smell_validity.evidence: One responsibility — what environment each sandboxed process observes — is genuinely split across five differently-shaped fragment helpers in five files plus per-site hand merges, with a glue trait papering over the shape mismatches. The natural prompt shows the cost: pinning one variable becomes a crate-wide dig. Locally sensible placements make the boundary from healthy design unmistakable.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Each new guarantee must be added to a fragment, categorized per request kind, and hand-merged at every lowering site, with machine-level rules re-decided at spawn and startup. Per-kind policy is duplicated across merge sites, so ordinary changes invite inconsistent application, as fairness covering only run/build shows. Repair restores one durable ownership boundary.

development_plausibility.evidence: The settings are real tool variables serving documented playground needs, placed where local instinct would put them and written in the crate's idioms; the story of tickets landing separately is credible. The engineered three-shape variation, matching glue trait, and narrated doc-comment rationales read partly as constructed accumulation rather than fully organic drift.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: A model maintainer contract: it demands a single readable owner consulted by lowerings, process starting, and startup; pins exact per-kind values, precedence, miri's variables, and the wire boundary; explicitly forecloses partial cleanups (whole-crate audit, both worker-side paths, retiring the merging glue) and unrelated redesign; leaves the owner's design open, with test commands pinning unchanged behavior.

semantic_diversity.evidence: At least five purposes need different code-supported decisions: flag-conditional run detail, unconditional rendering for other kinds, miri merging into its prebuilt map, spawn-time flooring under precedence, and startup seeding with an unset-only default. Uniform request-kind handling cannot serve the conditional, precedence, or process-level cases.

localization_burden.evidence: Fragment names and call sites are found by straightforward sweeps, but the prompt only names roles; deciding that the spawn-time floor and the pre-listening startup write belong to one policy requires combining coordinator-sent values with worker inheritance and precedence across modules. No aliasing, registration, or configuration-selection mechanism appears.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rules about the same settings interact across stages: coordinator-sent values outrank the worker's spawn-time additions, yet the worker's own startup defaults only when unset. Because stage-specific behavior for one key differs by site, a change at any one site cannot be settled without the others; unifying the rules breaks a preserved behavior.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform rule — mechanically relocating fragment definitions, whose call sites already share one spelling — covers the definition half of the spread, roughly a third of problem locations. Flag-conditional sites, miri's prebuilt map, spawn-time precedence, and startup process writes each require site-specific behavior, keeping single-rule coverage well under half.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Two silent failure paths exist: mis-assigning per-kind policy and mishandling miri's preserved variables; both compile, run, and produce plausible output, since colors, locale, job caps, and sysroot reuse surface only under specific conditions. The prompt's own verification skips miri runs, showing at least one path is unchecked.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
